    "## Trajectory Visualization"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Load the trajectory file by creating a MDAnalysis Universe object.\n",
    "Replace `PSF` to your own topology file and `DCD` to your own trajectory file."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/Resources/4.3/python/lib/python3.11/site-packages/MDAnalysis/coordinates/DCD.py:165: DeprecationWarning: DCDReader currently makes independent timesteps by copying self.ts while other readers update self.ts inplace.       "  warnings.warn(\"DCDReader currently makes independent timesteps\"\n"
     ]

   "source": [
    "u = mda.Universe(PSF, DCD)"

  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "You can apply any native Transformation in MDAnalysis to smooth the trajectory or correct periodic boundary condition (PBC) issues. For more details, refer to the [MDAnalysis trajectory transformations documentation](https://docs.mdanalysis.org/stable/documentation_pages/trajectory_transformations.html).\n",
    "\n",
    "Here, we add a smoothing transformation to the trajectory."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from MDAnalysis.transformations import PositionAverager\n",
    "N=5\n",
    "transformation = PositionAverager(N, check_reset=True)\n",
    "u.trajectory.add_transformations(transformation)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Initialize the GGMolVis object. It can be thought of as a `Figure` or a canvas for the molecular visualization."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "ggmv = GGMolVis()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "residues_ag = u.select_atoms('resid 127 40')\n",
    "protein_ag = u.select_atoms('protein')\n",
    "around_res = u.select_atoms('byres around 6 resid 40', updating=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

  {

   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "residue_mol = ggmv.trajectory(residues_ag)\n",
    "residue_around_mol = ggmv.trajectory(around_res, style='ball_and_stick')\n",
    "protein_mol = ggmv.trajectory(protein_ag, style='cartoon')\n",
    "protein_surface_mol = ggmv.trajectory(protein_ag, style='surface', material='transparent')"
   ]
  },
